The Trojans, led by second year head coach [[Kevin O'Neill (basketball)|Kevin O'Neill]], played their home games at the [[Galen Center]] and were members of the [[Pacific-10 Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 10–8 in Pac-10 play. They lost in the semifinals of the [[2011 Pacific-10 Conference men's basketball tournament]] to [[2010–11 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] where they lost in the new ''First Four'' round to [[2010–11 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]]. ==Class of
